_comment: Calls to Andy's phone. 'requests' are what people ring with (add as many as you like). 'brushOffs' are what Andy says when he fobs someone off; 'ticketLines' when he says he'll sort it. Cold callers: names, pitches, hang-up lines and the lines when Andy hears them out.
requests: Can we move Saturday's match to Sunday? And the pitch to Wales?
The council want to know why the pitch is mostly mud.
The referee's cancelled. Can you ref? And coach? And drive the minibus?
Has anyone handed in a set of false teeth? Found in the dugout.
Can my son have his birthday party in the centre circle?
We need the 60-page safeguarding form. By lunchtime.
The league says your goals are the wrong size.
Can we borrow all your cones? All of them. Forever.
The Chairman wants a team photo. Everyone smiling. Especially you.
Can the Under-8s play the Under-12s? For character building.
Somebody's parked on the penalty spot.
The groundsman's mower is in the canal again.
It's Matt. Any chance of the goalkeeper's shirt? I'll pay cash.
brushOffs: A problem, but not my problem.
Not my circus, not my clowns.
Put it in writing. In crayon.
I'll pass that on. To the bin.
We'll discuss it at the AGM. In 2031.
ticketLines: Yes. Of course. My pleasure. *grinds teeth*
coldCalls: Have you had an accident on a football pitch that wasn't your fault?
Have you considered plastic grass? Dogs can't dig it!
We can put solar panels on your dugouts!
Your mobile contract is due for an upgrade!
Floodlights so bright the neighbours will need sunglasses!
hearOutLines: Twenty minutes of my life. Gone.
I've agreed to something. I don't know what.
Now I've got a free brochure. Marvellous.
